name: Bias for action
definition: Speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

rows.justRight: We apply a good level of thinking to the magnitude of the problem and plan appropriately. Our planning time never takes up more than 5-10% of our execution time, i.e. a 1-week task can be planned in less than a few hours.
rows.over: We do work without thinking. We usually end up working on something that turns out to be useless.
